scripts.build: npm run build -w @close/frontend && npm run build -w @close/admin
scripts.check:go: cd services/backend && go test ./... && go vet ./...
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && wrangler dev -c workers/edge/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c workers/edge/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c workers/edge/wrangler.jsonc --env production
